meaning:
τρυγάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for קָצַר, בָּצַר, etc. ;]
to gather in: with accusative,
(a) of the fruit, Luk.6:44, Rev.14:18;
(b) of that from which it is gathered, Rev.14:19.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
